name: Banh mi bo nuong
summary: Bánh mì bò nướng is a baguette filled with marinated grilled beef, fragrant, soft, and sweet, with herbs, cucumber, and a special sauce.
origin: Vung Tau, on Nguyễn Thái Học.
taste: The marinated beef is fragrant, soft, and sweet, set against herbs, cucumber, and a special sauce.
howToEat: Eat it in the hand, as a snack.
seoTitle: Banh mi bo nuong — grilled-beef baguette in Vung Tau
seoDescription: A grilled-beef bánh mì on Nguyễn Thái Học: fragrant, sweet marinated beef with herbs, cucumber, and a special sauce.
